summary: Flash Sports Media Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Software Development and Technology Services Agreement with MindWave Innovations Inc., a subsidiary of Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US (NYSE American: APUS). MindWave will build FlashChain, a branded Layer-2 subnet on MindChain, for digital broadcasting-rights administration, video-asset and ticket-inventory tracking, anti-counterfeiting and fan data. Consideration is $506,000 of common stock in one installment after the 12-month term, priced at quarter-end, plus 20% of FLASH TOKEN issued quarterly. Watch token dilution, renewal economics (50% of Total Contract Value) and unregistered-sale compliance.
